description: Header file defining interfaces and data structures for CANopen network stack, including storage types, context, and function prototypes for storage handling, program download, and LED indicators.

methods.name: canopen_storage_attach
methods.description: Attaches storage handlers for CANopen object dictionary, enabling save/restore of parameters.

methods.name: canopen_storage_save
methods.description: Saves specified type of CANopen object dictionary entries to non-volatile storage.

methods.name: canopen_storage_erase
methods.description: Erases specified type of CANopen object dictionary entries from non-volatile storage.

methods.name: canopen_program_download_attach
methods.description: Attaches handlers for CANopen program download process.

methods.name: canopen_leds_init
methods.description: Initializes CANopen LED indicators with callbacks for green and red LEDs.

methods.name: canopen_leds_program_download
methods.description: Indicates whether a CANopen program download is in progress via LED status.
